policy: Tutorial-first delivery; ranks order work, not permission to bypass dependencies or close partially implemented issues. Earlier checkpoints may implement bounded slices of later-ranked owners. Unrelated roadmap work follows this path; urgent regressions interrupt it.

checkpoints.title: Constraint authoring and retained visual feedback
checkpoints.acceptance: Repeated constraint-first picks; Equal lines and five circles; driving edit; actual badges; Escape; finish, undo, reopen.

checkpoints.title: Exact first illustrated activity
checkpoints.acceptance: New document tab, origin outline, 500/100 lengths and two-line 45-degree angle; compare all constraint-stage captures.

checkpoints.title: Rounded profile and first solid
checkpoints.acceptance: Construction conversion, inferred end circles, two radius-100 sketch fillets, three selected regions and 50-mm Press Pull.

checkpoints.title: Face-supported sketch and referenced geometry
checkpoints.acceptance: Choose the top face, draw referenced construction, parallel constraints and stable upstream recompute.

checkpoints.title: Complete exact illustrated workflow
checkpoints.acceptance: Five inferred circles with inline diameter and Equal, five-profile arrow Cut, all source-step and visual checks; broader export gate stays separate.
